on.segmentText: Did Marigold get back to you about the room?
By the way, did Seabird 创客空间 get back to you about the laser-cutter training?
Did you ever get the chance to sketch the old water tower from the hill path?
你之前说想用尤克里里弹一首民谣的开头几小节，最近有摸到琴吗？
那第一页写得怎么样了？
你之前说在为社区意大利语餐桌活动学几句常用语，现在有空，要不要我陪你过两句？
Stonebridge 语言交流会那边今天应该有消息了吧，有进展吗？
A quiet stretch like this could be a good chance for that water tower sketch from the hill path.
